posts.title: How to ride UrbanEdge (carousel)
posts.description: 7-slide carousel: cover (5 stops route), STOP1 Find, STOP2 Choose, STOP3 Pay, STOP4 Lens, STOP5 Print, Last stop Share.

slides.title: Cover: 5 stops, no ticket needed
slides.description: Redone cover. Route of five labelled stops FIND / CHOOSE / PAY / POSE / PRINT, headline '5 stops. No ticket needed.'

slides.title: Stop 1: Find
slides.description: Follow the checkerboard floor to the Hwangridan-gil entrance.

slides.title: Stop 2: Choose
slides.description: Four platforms, pick your mood (Subway, Karaoke, Public Phone, Retro).

slides.title: Stop 3: Pay
slides.description: 4 cuts or 8 cuts, pay by card, cash, or coupon.

slides.title: Stop 4: Lens
slides.description: The lens is below the screen, not at face height.

slides.title: Stop 5: Print
slides.description: Pose, pick your best cuts, collect the print at the slot.

slides.title: Last stop: Share
slides.description: Share it, scratch it. Tag @__urbanedge for a coupon.
